subject: Expedited onboarding: invoice-only option for 6-week pilot
messages:
From: Ami Shah <ami@bluenimbus.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expedited onboarding: invoice-only option for 6-week pilot

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking the call yesterday. BlueNimbus would like to run a 6-week integration pilot of Redwood's hosted API. We're a small R&D org and can't commit a PO immediately — request an invoice-only (no-PO) onboarding path for the pilot while we finalize internal purchasing.

Key details:
- Pilot length: 6 weeks
- Estimated spend: ~$12k total (monthly invoices)
- Start target: week of May 24

What we can provide now: signed MSA, W-9, vendor contact, basic SSO info. We can fill whatever onboarding forms you need. Can procurement consider a temporary invoice-only flow with these safeguards?

Attaching our vendor intake and a brief risk summary.

Thanks,
Ami Shah
Head of Integrations
BlueNimbus Labs
Attachments: BlueNimbus_vendor_intake.pdf (pdf), risk-summary.txt (text)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expedited onboarding: invoice-only option for 6-week pilot

Hi Ami — thanks for the clear summary and for sending the intake docs.

I can get procurement to evaluate a temporary invoice-only path for a short pilot. I'll need procurement and finance to sign off on safeguards (spend cap, invoice cadence, evidence checklist). Looping in Marissa (Procurement) and Markus (Finance) to weigh in.

Next steps for us:
- Marissa: can you review the attached intake and risk summary and propose a safeguard checklist?
- Markus: what's the max invoice cadence and holdbacks Finance would require for a pilot this size?

Ami — if you can also return the completed Redwood onboarding form (attached) and W-9, that'll speed things up.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_onboarding_form.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Expedited onboarding: invoice-only option for 6-week pilot

Vanessa/Markus — quick internal note after reviewing BlueNimbus materials.

Summary of risk: small vendor, low technology risk, provided MSA/W-9; they appear VC-backed with standard controls. Proposed safeguards for a temporary no-PO path (6 weeks):
- Spend cap of $25,000 total or $12,500 per month, whichever is lower
- Invoice-only with 30-day payment terms; AP will issue payment upon receipt of approved invoice
- Require completed Redwood onboarding form, W-9, and vendor bank details before first invoice
- Procurement to set an internal 'pilot' vendor tag in the vendor portal and re-evaluate at pilot end
- Invoice approval routed to Vanessa + Finance for expedited sign-off

I've attached a one-page 'conditional allowlist checklist' that legal/procurement can sign off on. If Markus agrees to payment cadence, I think we can approve.

Marissa
Attachments: conditional-allowlist-checklist.pdf, supplier-risk-profile.xlsx

Ami — good news: procurement and finance have provisionally approved a temporary invoice-only onboarding for the 6-week pilot under the following conditions:

1) Pilot cap: $25,000 total. If spend approaches $20k we will pause and require PO
2) Required docs before first invoice: completed Redwood onboarding form (attached), signed MSA (received), W-9, and vendor banking details
3) Billing: monthly invoices, Net 30. Finance will expedite approvals to meet the pilot timeline.
4) Tagging & review: Procurement will mark BlueNimbus as 'pilot - invoice-only' in the vendor portal and will run a post-pilot review to determine standard PO requirements going forward
5) Term: this exception is valid only for the 6-week pilot. Any continued engagement beyond pilot requires standard PO or a contract amendment

Next steps for BlueNimbus:
- Return the completed redwood_onboarding_form.pdf and bank details (secure link or encrypted email)
- Send first invoice after the start date; mark 'Pilot Invoice - BlueNimbus' in the description

I've attached the conditional allowlist checklist and the supplier risk profile for your records. We'll also open a HubSpot deal (BN-4219) and a DocuSign envelope to collect any outstanding signatures.

If that all sounds good I can author the DocuSign today.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
